items.title: WTI, Brent Crude Oil, and Natural Gas Price Crash Today
items.summary: Oil and gas prices plummeted as the U.S.-Iran ceasefire led to a rapid unwind of geopolitical risk premiums. WTI crude dropped 17.26% to $93.45, Brent crude fell 15.30% to $92.55, and natural gas declined 4.70% to $2.73. The truce's impact on the Strait of Hormuz, a key global oil and LNG flow route, is significant. Despite the plunge, supply chain disruptions and infrastructure damages persist.

items.title: 吉林石化40万吨/年高密度聚乙烯装置投产
items.summary: 吉林石化乙烯厂转型升级项目40万吨/年高密度聚乙烯装置一次开车成功，标志着该装置正式转入生产运行阶段。该装置引进德国利安德巴塞尔公司先进低压淤浆工艺技术，可生产多种高性能牌号产品。

items.title: Natural Gas Price Update - June 11, 2026
items.summary: Natural gas prices rose to 3.19 USD/MMBtu on June 11, 2026, marking a 0.01% increase from the previous day. Over the past month, the price has risen by 12.04%, yet it remains 8.78% lower than a year ago. Analysts predict natural gas to trade at 3.29 USD/MMBtu by the end of this quarter and estimate it to reach 4.17 USD/MMBtu in 12 months.

items.title: Oil and Gas Prices Up Today Due to US Warship Incident Near Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Oil and gas markets experienced an increase after reports of a US warship incident near the Strait of Hormuz. Brent and WTI crude futures rose about 5%, and Dutch gas prices moved up as LNG supply remained trapped. Market focus is now on supply disruption risks, OPEC+ output plans, storage levels, and geopolitical developments.

items.title: 浙江石化计划2026年第一季度启动新的LDPE/EVA切换式装置
items.summary: 浙江石化计划于2026年第一季度在中国舟山启动新的年产30万吨低密度聚乙烯(LDPE)/乙烯醋酸乙烯（EVA）切换式装置。

items.title: 国内聚丙烯产量增加，新装置投产
items.summary: 本周国内聚丙烯产量80.88万吨，相较上周增加2.25万吨，涨幅2.86%。周内泉州国亨、京博聚烯烃、延长中煤、中原石化及恒力石化等前期检修装置集中恢复，加之大榭石化二期二线45万吨/年新装置投产，聚丙烯供应端增量明显。

items.title: 独山子石化塔里木120万吨/年二期乙烯项目
items.summary: 总投资约200亿元的独山子石化塔里木120万吨/年二期乙烯项目计划2026年6月30日中交，9月30日投产。项目进入收尾冲刺关键阶段，关键节点接连突破。

items.title: 2026年中国化工行业预计新增PP产能570万吨
items.summary: 2026年PP预计新增产能570万吨，总产能将首次突破5000万吨大关。新增产能多集中在下半年，预计下半年市场供应压力将显著增加。

items.title: Oil Market Trend Analysis
items.summary: During the Asian morning session, U.S. crude traded near $62.15 per barrel, as OPEC+'s decision for modest November production increases balanced against potential global supply surplus. OPEC+ announced a daily production increase of 137,000 barrels starting in November, below market expectations. The IEA's surplus forecasts remind investors that the oil market may enter a new phase of strong supply and weak demand.

items.title: EIA Raises 2026 US Dry Nat-Gas Production Forecast
items.summary: On Tuesday, the EIA increased its forecast for 2026 US dry natural gas production to 111.0 bcf/day from a May estimate of 110.6 bcf/day. This adjustment reflects expectations for continued growth in the US natural gas sector.

items.title: 2026年炼厂计划内检修情况统计
items.summary: 2026年已公布18家常规计划内检修的主营炼厂，检修产能为14790万吨，同比2025年检修产能下降8.98%，预计主营产量较去年应有所增长。

items.title: Oil & Natural Gas Corpn Ltd Share Price Drops
items.summary: Oil & Natural Gas Corpn Ltd's share price fell by -1.62%, trading at 285.25. Investors are assessing the implications of this drop, considering the stock's PE ratio of 8.1100, ROE of 9.9235, and debt to equity ratio of 0.4786.
